recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5904 unless Patient Care separately decides to revisit the later abatementBoolean removal.
issue_request: FHIR-5904 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core Condition and requested adding Period, Range, and string to Condition.onset[x] and Condition.abatement[x] so imprecise age/date/string values could be represented like FamilyMemberHistory; comments clarified the then-existing abatement boolean was not to be removed by this issue.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in svn revision 4816, mirrored by git commit e1e29f4ad6c14edf8a8ea1000cb53f1b7fc5b2c8, which changed the Condition spreadsheet onset types from dateTime | Age to dateTime | Age | Period | Range | string and abatement types from date | Age | boolean to date | Age | boolean | Period | Range | string.
additional_context: Condition is active in source/fhir.ini. Current structuredefinition-Condition.xml has dateTime, Age, Period, Range, and string for both onset[x] and abatement[x], and current Condition search parameters cover Age/Range, dateTime/Period, and string. The historical abatementBoolean choice was intentionally removed later by Published issue FHIR-13201, implemented in bac396f21d6dc845c746e29a9fb7c79e27ee6ff5 and confirmed by FHIR-13525.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested imprecise choices are already present in the active current source and related search-parameter bundle; reintroducing abatementBoolean would contradict later final Condition history.
